description: This file defines a static internal class 'Extensions' that provides extension methods for numeric and TimeSpan types, including ceiling operations to round up to the nearest upper second.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Provides internal syntax sugar extension methods for rounding operations on doubles and TimeSpan objects.

methods.name: Int32Ceiling
methods.description: Converts a double to the smallest integer greater than or equal to the value.

methods.name: TotalSecondsCeiling
methods.description: Returns the total seconds of a TimeSpan rounded up to the nearest integer second.

methods.name: SecondsCeiling
methods.description: Converts the total seconds of a TimeSpan, rounded up, back to a TimeSpan representing whole seconds.
